notes.title: New season, season 4 begins
notes.content:
Update Jan 1, 2024
Commanders!
Welcome to the New Era and Happy New Year!
The 4th Season of our game has begun, which means we have new content for battlepass and more importantly---new balance adjustment.
--New Season--
We have a lot of new content for our BattlePass, including a new little hero and new artifacts.
For more details, please check in game.
--Balance Update--
 - Witch Doctor (Orc, Tier 4):
Old - Exploit(4) : Exploit progress of other legion +1. When other legion triggered Exploit, gain +1 amount
New - When other legion triggered Exploit, gain +1 amount
 - Demon hunter (Human, Tier 5):
Old - Gain 1 gold when completing 3 Tasks
New - Gain 1 gold when completing 4 Tasks
 - Naga (Elf, Tier 6):
Old - At the end of turn: All elven legions gain +1 Spiritual Power,for every legion with more than 5 Spiritual Powers, gain +1 amount
New - At the end of turn: All elven legions gain +1 Spiritual Power
 - Demon Warrior (Undead, Tier 4):
When triggered Sacrifice, they will no longer get legions more than Tier 4
 - Blood Demon(Undead, Tier 5)
Tier 5 ==> Tier 6
--Other Updates--
 - Added Orb of Wisdom to Shard Mall
We value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!
Best regards,
The Game Development Team

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
[h1]Update Nov 13, 2023[/h1]
Commanders!
Here comes the newest update! 
The enhancements we made to Elf far exceeded our expectations and had a big impact on balance.
So we decided to roll back the strength of some of the Elves' legions.
[h2]--Balance Update--[/h2]
[list]
[*]  - Naga(Elf, Tier 6):
[*] Old - At the end of turn: All elven legions gain +1 Spiritual Power. For every 5 Spiritual Powers in this legion, gain +1 amount
[*] New - At the end of turn: All elven legions gain +1 Spiritual Power,for every legion with more than 5 Spiritual Powers, gain +1 amount
[/list]
--Bug Fixed--
 - Fixed a glitch where Naga had abnormal amounts growth
We value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!
Best regards,
The Game Development Team

notes.title: Fixed a bug in elves that caused balance issues
notes.content:
[h1]Update Log - Nov 6, 2023[/h1]
[h2]Greetings, Commanders![/h2]

We are excited to share the most recent updates with you. The changes we introduced to the 'Elf' in the last update significantly surpassed our expectations and affected the game balance in a substantial way. This has led us to make a decision to reduce the strength of some Elf Legions in order to restore the balance of the game.

[h1]Balance Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h2]Divine Twinhound (Elf, Tier 5): [/h2]
[*] [h2]Old Abilities:[/h2] At the end of the turn: Absorb 1 Spiritual Power from adjacent Elven Legion. For each Spiritual Power absorbed, gain a +2 amount.

[*] [h2]New Abilities:[/h2] At the end of the turn: Absorb 1 Spiritual Power from adjacent Elven Legion. For each Spiritual Power absorbed, gain a +1 amount. Additionally, absorbed Spiritual Powers are now directly destroyed instead of being transferred to the Legion.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have fixed a glitch where Divine Twinhound was having abnormal amounts of unused Spiritual Power.
[/list]
We highly value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these latest fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. As always, we thank you for playing!


[h2]Best regards,

The Game Development Team[/h2]

notes.title: The Third Season Starts
notes.content:
[h1]Game's Update Log[/h1]
[h3]Update Oct 27, 2023[/h3]

Welcome Commanders to the New Era! This is the 3rd Season of our game which presents new content for BattlePass and more importantly---new balance adjustment.

[h1]New Season[/h1]
We have a lot of new content for our BattlePass, including a new little hero, more stickers, and new artifacts. For more details, please check in-game.

[h1]Balance Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Elven Assassin (Elf, Tier 3)
[list]
[*] Old: When deployed, give adjacent Elven Legion +1 Spiritual Powers
[*] New: Battlecry: give adjacent Elven Legion +1 Spiritual Powers
[/list]
[*] Fox Assassin (Elf, Tier 4)
[list]
[*] Old: Gain +1 amount when you gain Spiritual Powers
[*] New: Gain +1 amount when any legion gain Spiritual Powers
[/list]
[*] Divine Twinhound (Elf, Tier 5)
[list]
[*] Old: At the end of turn: gains +1 for every 5 Spiritual Powers
[*] New: At the end of turn: absorb 1 Spiritual Power from adjacent elven legion, for each Spiritual Power absorbed gain +2 amount
[/list]
[*] Naga (Elf, Tier 6)
[list]
[*] Old: Tier 4, Each time another Legion triggers 2 Naturebless, this Legion gains +1
[*] New: At the end of turn: All Elven legions gain +1 Spiritual Power, for every 5 Spiritual Powers this legion has, gain +1 amount
[/list]
[*] Slightly reduced the damage of Turtle Fighter and Giant Treant
[*] Demon Warlock (Undead, Tier 4)
[list]
[*] Old: Gain +1 amount when Sacrifice triggered
[*] New: Gain +2 amount when Sacrifice triggered
[/list]
[*] Slightly reduced the damage of RTX-08
[*] Death Knight no longer has the aura that can make dead units live longer.
[*] Reduce the duration of invincible status of the Hellstone Demon when casting skill.
[/list]
Other Updates
Added the King's Trumpet to Shard Mall.

We value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!

Best regards,

The Game Development Team

notes.title: Adjustments to Human Cards
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update - October 27, 2023[/b][/h1]

Dear Commanders, Welcome to our newest update!
We've noticed the Undead's overall strength is currently too strong so we've decided to improve other races' competitiveness to maintain a healthy gaming environment. These changes will gradually be introduced to the game. We've decided to first modify the Human race.

[h2][b]Balance Update[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Wizard (Human Tier 3):[/b]
[*]     [b]Old:[/b] The first time you complete the Task in each turn, gain +2 amount
[*]     [b]New:[/b] Task: Refresh the Barrack 2 times. Reward: Gain +2 amount
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Crossbows (Human Tier 4):[/b]
[*]     [b]Old:[/b] Task: Refresh the barrack 4 times. Reward: Gain +1 amount
[*]     [b]New:[/b] Each time other Legions triggers Union 2 times, this Legion gains +1
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Ninja (Human Tier 4):[/b]
[*]     [b]Old:[/b] The number of legions to trigger Union -1; each 2 Union triggered by other legions on the field, this legion gets +1
[*]     [b]New:[/b]  At the end of Turn: Trigger Union effect of 2 random legions
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Frost Bringer (Neutral):[/b]
[*]     Power 1500 => 1000
[*]     ATK 96 => 86
[*]     HP 860 => 660
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Frost Magic Vial (Artifact):[/b]
[*]     At the Start of turn: If the combat power is higher than 2000 (raised from 1000), gain Frost Bringer and replace this ability with: Destroy legions on a field, giving Ice Movers +1 for every 1000 Power
[/list]
We value your feedback and appreciate your support. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!
Best regards,
The Game Development Team

Update Oct 16, 2023
Commanders!
Recently, we have received several feedbacks about bots and difficulties. We've made some changes to the bots in the game
--Bots Enhancement--
Now, if there are bots in a game, one of them will be selected and enhanced after a certain number of turns to match the player's combat power growth rate and level.
--Balance Update--
 - The maximum amount of Giant Treant reduced from 40 to 25
We value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!
Best regards,
The Game Development Team

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
Update Sep 10, 2023
Commanders!
Since our last update, we have once again focused on the balance of the game. We find that the overall strength of humanity is low at present, and the problem is mainly economic. So we focused on Demon Hunter. Also, there are some legions that were op has been tweaked a little.
--Balance Update--
Goblin lords (Special legion): The amount of Goblin lord can only be increased by artifact skill, other ways of increasing will be added to the field random legion.
Orc Hellcaller(Orc, Tier 6): will now only trigger the Battlecry of Orc legions only
Demon Hunter(Human, Tier 5): effects can be stacked and progress will be calculated separately
Armored Cavalry(Human, Tier 3): the demand for task reduced to 5
Crossbows(Human, Tier 4):the demand for task reduced to 4
--Optimization&Bug Fixed--
Optimized the effect freeze time of all legions(especially Germinate and Naturebless effects)
--Steam Wishlist--
Our game will be released on steam soon! Everyone could now add to the wishlist via the button on the right of lobby so that you will be informed once the game is released!
We value your feedback and appreciate your support in identifying these issues. We hope these fixes and improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for playing!
Best regards,
The Game Development Team
